title: The Keith house's loggia gains its second row of columns
items: The 1888 photograph shows a second pair of columns behind each front pair of the north loggia at 1808 Prairie. Both pairs are now built, standing against the house wall.
Their depth, spacing and slimmer shafts are measured from the photograph. The model lands within two pixels of the print.
A 1967 photograph's lit column between the front pairs turns out to be the new south pair.
